gaia_source_id: # Curated exceptions to the label merge's mechanical rule (overlay wins on
# disagreement, docs/catalog-driver.md § 4). One row per record per identifier;
# an empty `value` keeps the spine's. `#` in the first column comments a line —
# the header stays the first line, as every committed TSV's does.
# ONE ROW. Nearly every one of today's 137 disagreements is either a real AT-HYG
# cross-ID error the overlay corrects (Izar: AT-HYG's HR 5505 against IV/27A +
# V/50's HR 5506, and ε Boo IS HR 5506) or a resolved close pair whose two
# components the two catalogues letter oppositely — neither is the CDS join being
# wrong, which is the only thing this file is for. The full enumeration with
# dispositions is data/classic-ids/label_flips.tsv.
# Propus (η Gem, HIP 29655) is the exception, and the shape to recognise: Gaia
# fits ONE source where Tycho-2 resolves two entries, and its TYC cross-match
# keys that source to the SECONDARY. IV/25 gives the record's own
# TYC 1877-1716-1 HD 42995 and the sibling TYC 1877-1716-2 HD 253820; SIMBAD
# binds source 3377072212924335488 to η Gem, which is why the record binds it
# (simbad_corroborated). The overlay reaches that source through the sibling's
# TYC alone, so it proposes 253820 as the record's only HD — no alias list, no
# sibling extra, just § 4 precedence handing a star its neighbour's number and
# folding the neighbour's own record away as a component.
# Gl 563.2 A/B is the second shape, and the opposite failure: the overlay is
# RIGHT and the merge cannot hear it. CNS5 rows 3664/3665, SIMBAD and the HIP
# agree that 6228695236338166528 (HIP 72509, the fainter, CD-25 10553B) is
# component B and 6228695270698475392 (HIP 72511, CD-25 10553A) is A; AT-HYG
# letters them the opposite way round. The merge compares `gl` on the bare GJ
# number with the component letter stripped, so a SWAPPED letter reads as
# agreement and section 4 precedence never fires. Both records key hip:, so no
# sid rides on either cell. What a class-level rule would have to say instead:
# scripts/catalog/classic-ids/README.md section Counts and the parity
# measurement.
# Two shapes DO NOT belong here, because a label exception is the wrong tool:
#   - an addition that would make another record's designation ambiguous is
#     withheld mechanically by the collision guard (p Eridani, Gl 277A);
#   - a Gliese renumbering (Gl 157.1 -> GJ 9140) is an identity bridge in
#     data/sid/sameas-overrides.tsv, since both designations name the star.
